title: Formation of a samarium alkoxide–aryloxide complex containing a novel butterfly framework: X-ray crystal structures of Sm4(μ3-O-i-Pr)3(μ2-O-i-Pr)4(O-i-Pr)2(O-2,6-i-Pr2C6H3)3(THF) and [Ti(O-i-Pr)2(O-2,6-i-Pr2C6H3)(μ-O-i-Pr)]2

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: tetranuclear samarium alkoxide–aryloxide butterfly complex Sm4(μ3-O-i-Pr)3(μ2-O-i-Pr)4(O-i-Pr)2(O-2,6-i-Pr2C6H3)3(THF)·n-hexane solvate

synthesis.procedure: All manipulations were carried out under oxygen-free UHP argon using Schlenk techniques or under oxygen-free helium in a drybox. To a stirred solution of Sm[N(SiMe3)2]3 (0.500 g, 0.792 mmol) in toluene (5 mL) was added 440 μL (2.37 mmol) of 2,6-di-iso-propylphenol followed by 236 μL (0.79 mmol) of titanium iso-propoxide. After stirring overnight at room temperature, all solvent was removed under vacuum to leave a viscous yellow oil. This was dissolved in hexane/THF (20:1, 10 mL) and the solution placed in the −35 °C drybox freezer. Over several days a small number of pale yellow crystals of 1 were deposited. Crystallography found two n-hexane molecules in the lattice, refined at half occupancy.
synthesis.temperature: stirred overnight at room temperature; crystallization at −35 °C
synthesis.time: overnight stirring; crystals deposited over several days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk/drybox inert-atmosphere alcoholysis; crystallization from hexane/THF in a drybox freezer
